designationHistory.indexText: It was established in 1982 to protect what remained of the unique wetlands of the San Bernardino ciénega, a wetland that was historically considered the largest, most extensive in the region.
designationHistory.note: The refuge page gives only the month or year. The refuge page does not say how it was established.
